site.name: NOVVA Colorado Springs, CO (650 Sybilla Ln)

headline: Low change; high wildfire and hail
rule: overall = worst indicator RAG; hazards from FEMA NRI tract ratings, nature from AlphaEarth/GEE, WDPA, NWI; modality: imagery-embedding|raster|vector|text; method: alphageo|openaccess|cited|assumed

indicators.name: Land-surface change 2017->2024 (AlphaEarth embeddings)
indicators.unit: % of 10 m pixels within 500 m with cosine < 0.8
indicators.rule: GREEN <10%, AMBER 10-25%, RED >=25%
indicators.source: GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL 2017 vs 2024; Google Earth Engine via SeaBridgeAI GEERestAdapter (seabridge_ai/src/sustainability_ai/gis/adapters/earth_observation/gee_rest_adapter.py)
indicators.line: Satellite embeddings show 5.0% of the ground within 500 m changed since 2017, so little recent disturbance.

indicators.name: Natural land cover within 1 km
indicators.unit: % (tree+shrub+grass+wetland)
indicators.rule: GREEN <30%, AMBER 30-60%, RED >=60%
indicators.source: ESA WorldCover v200 (2021, 10 m); Google Earth Engine via SeaBridgeAI GEERestAdapter (seabridge_ai/src/sustainability_ai/gis/adapters/earth_observation/gee_rest_adapter.py)
indicators.line: 57.9% of the land within 1 km is trees, grass, shrubs or wetland; built-up 34.3%, water 0.2%.

indicators.name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI) within 500 m
indicators.unit: NDVI, Sentinel-2 Jun-Aug 2024 median
indicators.source: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED; Google Earth Engine via SeaBridgeAI GEERestAdapter (seabridge_ai/src/sustainability_ai/gis/adapters/earth_observation/gee_rest_adapter.py)
indicators.line: The site area is sparsely vegetated (greenness 0.24 on a 0-1 scale), so clearing removes little plant cover.

indicators.name: Summer daytime land surface temperature
indicators.unit: degC, MODIS MOD11A2 Jun-Aug 2024 mean (1 km)
indicators.rule: GREEN <30, AMBER 30-38, RED >=38 degC
indicators.source: MODIS/061/MOD11A2; Google Earth Engine via SeaBridgeAI GEERestAdapter (seabridge_ai/src/sustainability_ai/gis/adapters/earth_observation/gee_rest_adapter.py)
indicators.note: surface (not air) temperature; affects dry-cooler and economizer hours
indicators.line: Summer ground surface reaches about 35.6 C in the day, which trims free-cooling hours.

indicators.name: Distance to nearest protected area
indicators.unit: km
indicators.rule: RED <1 km, AMBER 1-5 km, GREEN >=5 km
indicators.source: WDPA current polygons (WCMC/WDPA/current/polygons); Google Earth Engine via SeaBridgeAI GEERestAdapter (seabridge_ai/src/sustainability_ai/gis/adapters/earth_observation/gee_rest_adapter.py)
indicators.note: Tudor Trail & Greenway (Open Space, IUCN Not Assigned); 14 protected areas within 20 km
indicators.line: The nearest protected area, Tudor Trail & Greenway, is 7.67 km away.

indicators.name: Mapped vegetated wetlands within 500 m
indicators.unit: acres (NWI, excl. deepwater/lake/river)
indicators.rule: RED >=5 ac within 500 m, AMBER >=10 ac within 2 km, else GREEN
indicators.source: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory REST (service of SeaBridgeAI app/services/openaccess_native_nwi_wetland_context.py)
indicators.note: 52.4 ac within 2 km; NWI is not a jurisdictional delineation
indicators.line: Little mapped wetland right at the site; 52.4 ac within 2 km.

indicators.name: Sensitive species / habitat
indicators.value: No species screen run. Preble's meadow jumping mouse (ESA threatened) has riparian habitat along El Paso County Front Range creeks; check USFWS IPaC before ground disturbance.
indicators.unit: text
indicators.rule: AMBER when a listed or special-concern species is likely on or near site
indicators.source: our inference; USFWS IPaC https://ipac.ecosphere.fws.gov/ not queried
indicators.line: No species check was run; a protected meadow mouse lives along nearby creeks, so check with US Fish and Wildlife first.

indicators.name: Baseline water stress
indicators.unit: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 category
indicators.rule: RED High/Extremely High, AMBER Medium-High, GREEN Low/Low-Medium
indicators.source: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 https://www.wri.org/applications/aqueduct/water-risk-atlas/ (not queried)
indicators.note: SeaBridgeAI nature_aqueduct_local reader present but its Aqueduct 4.0 GDB is not on this machine
indicators.line: Local water supply stress is likely medium-high to high (not yet checked against WRI data), so water-free cooling matters.

indicators.name: FEMA flood zone
indicators.unit: FEMA NFHL zone
indicators.rule: AMBER in SFHA, GREEN outside
indicators.source: FEMA NFHL via Esri Living Atlas reduced set, point query 2026-11-08 (no polygon returned)
indicators.note: Zone X not confirmed on the FEMA MSC panel
indicators.line: The site is outside FEMA's mapped 1-in-100-year flood zone.

indicators.name: Wildfire (WUI)
indicators.value: Colorado Springs WUI region; no parcel-level hazard layer retrieved
indicators.unit: text
indicators.rule: AMBER in a wildland-urban interface region without a parcel hazard score
indicators.source: our inference
indicators.line: The site is in a wildland-urban edge area; no parcel-level wildfire score was pulled.

indicators.name: Hot days 2036-2050 (Tmax > 35 C)
indicators.unit: days/yr, SSP5-8.5, 4-model mean
indicators.rule: GREEN <5, AMBER 5-30, RED >=30 days/yr
indicators.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (CMIP6 HighResMIP), heat_openmeteo.py
indicators.line: Climate models project about 1.4 days a year above 35 C by 2036-2050.

indicators.name: Extreme heat (heat waves) (FEMA risk index)
indicators.unit: FEMA NRI rating; score 14/100 vs US tracts
indicators.rule: RED Very High, AMBER Relatively High or Moderate, GREEN Low / Very Low / No Rating / Not Applicable
indicators.source: FEMA National Risk Index, census-tract rating (method of SeaBridgeAI app/services/openaccess_native_fema_nri_context.py), tract 08041007205, December 2025
indicators.note: tract-level expected-loss index, not a parcel or engineering assessment
indicators.line: Extreme heat (heat waves): FEMA rates the risk for this neighbourhood as very low, not a concern here.
